title: Stopping, pausing and seeking while following a beat clock
description:
As a performer, I want Apricity to stop when the clock stops and to come back in on a bar line, so that starting and stopping in the DAW never leaves Apricity out of step.

Spec file: `features/link/clock.feature`.

```gherkin
Feature: Stopping, pausing and seeking while following a beat clock

  Background:
    Given the click score
    And playback is following a clock at 120 BPM with a quantum of 4

  Scenario: The clock stops
    When the clock stops at beat 13.2
    Then the sound fades out within 5 ms of that moment
    And nothing sounds afterwards

  Scenario: The clock plays again
    Given the clock stopped
    When the clock plays from beat 0
    Then bar 1 of the score sounds at beat 0 within the tolerance

  Scenario: Pausing playback leaves the clock alone
    When I pause playback at beat 10
    Then nothing sounds and the clock keeps playing
    When I press play at beat 17
    Then bar 1 of the score sounds at beat 20 within the tolerance

  Scenario: Seeking picks the bar that starts at the next bar line
    When I seek to bar 3 at beat 13
    Then bar 3 of the score sounds at beat 16 within the tolerance
```
